auditor_summary: Task 2 diagnosis evidence bundle. Two DISTINCT root causes found for the marriage-domain-zero-windows question; neither is real astrological physics.

result_summary.empty_reason: no kala_gochara_windows row spans this date for this chart/event_class/domain filter — an honest zero-activation result, not a fabricated one

result_summary.note: domain='relationship' (the CORRECT domain value for the marriage event_class per brahma_event_ontology.domain) returns the marriage window that domain='marriage' silently missed.

5 of 22 possible today-active generation=3.0 rows surfaced (DB has exactly 1 authoritative generation=3.0 row per event_class overlapping today, across 22 classes) -- consistent with ORDER BY window_start ASC, signed_intensity DESC + implicit response-budget trim; marriage (signed_intensity 0.35) ranks near the bottom of the tied-window_start cohort and is trimmed out, same as several other legitimate low-intensity classes.

db_verification.sql_used: SELECT event_class_id, domain FROM brahma_event_ontology WHERE event_class_id='marriage' -> domain='relationship' (NOT 'marriage')

root_cause_A_domain_naming_trap.claim: 'marriage' is only ever an EVENT_CLASS in brahma_event_ontology, never a domain value -- its domain column resolves to 'relationship'. Any caller (human or the tool's own description text, which uses 'marriage'/'health'/'career' interchangeably as illustrative domain examples) who passes domain='marriage' to gochara_activation_get/gochara_forecast_get gets a well-formed, honestly-labeled, but FALSE zero-window result, because no kala_gochara_windows row's resolved domain literally equals the string 'marriage'.
root_cause_A_domain_naming_trap.mechanism_file: platform-mcp/src/tools/retrieval/register_gochara_windows.ts (domain filter WHERE clause joins/filters against brahma_event_ontology.domain, which is 'relationship' for event_class='marriage', not 'marriage')
root_cause_A_domain_naming_trap.verified_workaround: domain='relationship' or event_class='marriage' both correctly surface the live, authoritative, currently-active marriage window.

root_cause_B_dead_capability_uri.claim: kala_now_get's (and kala_explain_get's) gochara_narrative.field_gochara_alignment is 'insufficient_data' UNCONDITIONALLY for every chart and every domain -- not specific to marriage at all -- because fetchGocharaForecastWindows() calls callRegistryCapability('marsys://tool/L4/gochara_forecast_get', ...), and NO capability with 'gochara' anywhere in its URI is registered in platform/src/lib/retrieval/registry (grep across every registerCapability call and every layers/*/index.ts in the whole platform repo returns zero matches for a gochara-related uri). The call therefore 404s against /api/retrieval/capability/route.ts (getCapability(uri) returns null -> 404), callRegistryCapability's catch-all returns {content:null, ok:false}, and fetchGocharaForecastWindows unconditionally returns [] on !resp.ok (now.ts:1381). With activeWindows.length===0, the alignment logic (now.ts:1426-1428) always assigns 'insufficient_data'.
root_cause_B_dead_capability_uri.mechanism_file: platform-mcp/src/tools/kala_views/now.ts:1359-1394 (fetchGocharaForecastWindows) + :1373 (dead URI 'marsys://tool/L4/gochara_forecast_get') + :1381 (silent [] fallback on !resp.ok) + :1426-1428 (insufficient_data assignment); identical dead-URI reference at platform-mcp/src/tools/kala_views/explain.ts:476; confirmed absent from registry via grep -rn "uri: '[^']*gochara[^']*'" platform/src (zero hits) and grep -rn 'marsys://tool/L4/gochara' platform/src (zero hits).
root_cause_B_dead_capability_uri.distinguishing_note: This is a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT defect from root_cause_A. Root cause A is a live, working tool (gochara_activation_get/gochara_forecast_get, served from platform-mcp/src/tools/retrieval/register_gochara_windows.ts, a local MCP-tool-level implementation) being called with the wrong parameter value. Root cause B is a dead pointer inside kala_now_get/kala_explain_get's OWN internal narrative-composition code, which reaches for a registry capability that was apparently never actually registered under that URI -- the real gochara substrate is fully populated and correct; only this specific internal HTTP round-trip to the platform app's capability router is broken.

verdict.summary: Neither zero-windows result reflects real astrological physics or missing underlying data. The marriage event class is richly populated (4627 total rows, 13 authoritative generation=3.0 rows spanning 1984-2084, one row actively covering 2026-08-15 today with a full drishti_contact/kakshya_cell_crossing term_breakdown). The apparent zero results are two SEPARATE, genuinely different code-level defects: (A) a domain-vs-event_class vocabulary mismatch that produces a false honest-empty when callers naturally pass domain='marriage', and (B) a completely dead/unregistered registry-capability URI inside kala_now_get/kala_explain_get's narrative composer that makes field_gochara_alignment read 'insufficient_data' for every chart, every domain, unconditionally -- not a marriage-specific symptom at all.
verdict.relation_to_prior_finding_4: Confirms prior finding #4's field_gochara_alignment:'insufficient_data' symptom is real and reproducible (root_cause_B). The prior diagnosis reportedly 'blamed the wrong subsystem' -- consistent with what we found: the underlying kala_gochara_windows/gochara sweep substrate (22 gochara windows covering today, as the prior finding described) is fully healthy; the actual defect is the dead capability URI in the kala_now_get/kala_explain_get narrative-assembly code, one layer above the substrate that a naive diagnosis would have blamed.
